ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) across ~95% of surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to lateral tips and specific scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark gray/black across the central and medial lobe regions; high-contrast white focal clusters located at the distal lateral margins (tips) of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct U-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 125 degrees and moderate depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitude increases significantly at the lateral tips due to external growth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; trailing edge displays a moderate concave curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the far-left and far-right lateral extremities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent horizontal white linear disruption located in the mid-section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes; visible horizontal linear scar on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip exhibits a more pronounced, jagged irregular contour compared to the left tip.
